baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction قادرين على أن نسوي بنانه joins operative capacity, fashioning, and the fingertips.
baseline_models.mechanism: Effective capacity culminates in making the body's terminal members sound and complete; the extremity becomes the resolution limit of the act.

activation_trace.role: Capacity reaching effective control supplies an ability that can actually execute the promised formation.
Internal straightness and sound completion make نسوي the finishing of a well-formed body.
Fingertips and extremities locate that completion at the body's terminal detail.

changed_reading.before: A general assertion that bodily formation is possible.
changed_reading.after: The assertion reaches the body's articulated edge: complete re-formation includes the fingertips, not merely gross anatomy.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roots of قادرين and نسوي converge on measure, fitting proportion, and equivalence at بنانه.
baseline_models.mechanism: Deliberate measurement sets the several extremities into fitting correspondence, so restoration preserves relations and proportions rather than merely supplying parts.

activation_trace.role: Arrangement by estimate and deliberation supplies intentional calibration.
Fitting proportion supplies correspondence to an intended bodily measure.
Equality between things makes the relations among the several digits active.
The plural field of fingers and extremities supplies the members being mutually proportioned.

changed_reading.before: The fingertips are simply replaced as missing parts.
changed_reading.after: The fingertips are deliberately restored in their measured correspondence, with their internal and bodily relations intact.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding challenge moves from collecting dispersed hard structure to completing terminal soft articulation; بنانه marks the increasing granularity of the answer.

activation_trace.role: Effective control makes the answer an executable reconstruction claim.
Sound completion supplies the finishing operation after collection.
Fingertips and extremities provide the reconstruction's finest named endpoint.
Joining what was dispersed supplies the prior material phase to which 75:4 responds.
Hard bone supplies the coarse structural object contrasted with fingertip detail.

structural_cues: The question in 75:3 is answered by بلى in 75:4, while its object narrows from bones to fingertips.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispersed collection, hard bones, sound completion, and terminal members; I infer that the bone-to-fingertip shift increases reconstruction resolution, while the live alternative is that fingertips are only an emphatic example.

changed_reading.before: The ayah independently asserts fine bodily formation.
changed_reading.after: The ayah answers the denial of bone collection by carrying reconstruction beyond the skeleton all the way to terminal articulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human reckoning is enclosed by divine measure and deliberate proportion: the response does not merely oppose a conclusion but replaces a faulty estimate with operative calibration.

activation_trace.role: Measure reaching a thing's full extent supplies the answer's exact counter-measure.
Deliberative arrangement turns measurement into a controlled operation.
Sound completion is the concrete result that corrects the human estimate.
Counting and accounting activate a human calculation set against exact divine measure.
Conjectural reckoning repeats the epistemic error near the creation sequence.

structural_cues: The repeated أَيَحْسَبُ at 75:3 and 75:36 brackets both 75:4 and the closing account of human formation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies counting or conjecture on the human side and measure plus planned proportion in the focus; I infer a contest between estimates, while the alternative is that حسب contributes only ordinary supposition without numerical force.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a bare correction of disbelief in power.
changed_reading.after: The ayah overturns a human miscalculation by presenting measured, executable formation down to the fingertips.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across body, cosmos, and recitation, collection is followed by ordered articulation and disclosure; نسوي بنانه becomes the bodily instance in which gathered material regains a distinct, followable arrangement.

activation_trace.role: Sound completion supplies ordering after elements have been gathered.
The several fingers supply an articulated array rather than an undifferentiated mass.
Joining dispersed bones establishes collection in the bodily domain.
Joining formerly separate celestial bodies extends the collection pattern to cosmic scale.
Joining what is dispersed introduces collection in the recitational domain.
Reading and recitation turn collection into an articulated sequence.
Following trace after trace supplies ordered succession rather than mere aggregation.
Disclosure by speech or sign supplies the intelligibility of the completed order.

structural_cues: جمع recurs over bones in 75:3, sun and moon in 75:9, and recitation in 75:17, followed by following and clarification in 75:18-19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three collections plus recitation, following, and clarification; I infer a shared collection-to-order operation and map digits to articulated units, while the live alternative is that the three uses of جمع remain independent.

changed_reading.before: Reconstruction means putting bodily matter back together.
changed_reading.after: Reconstruction also restores ordered articulation: the gathered body regains distinct terminal units just as collected recitation regains sequence and clarity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exact restoration preserves the embodied self as a recognizably continuous agent; terminal organs are restored within the same self that possesses inward sight despite offered excuses.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate, exact arrangement supports continuity rather than generic replacement.
Fingertips and extremities supply the restored body's action-bearing edge.
The thing itself or its very identity supplies continuity of the accountable subject.
Inner sight makes the restored self an insider witness rather than only an observed object.

structural_cues: The report of what the human advanced and delayed in 75:13 leads into self-insight and failed excuses in 75:14-15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact terminal restoration, the self itself, inner sight, and an action report; I infer that bodily precision preserves accountable agency, while the alternative is that fingertips function only as proof of power with no evidentiary role.

changed_reading.before: Fingertip precision displays technical power over anatomy.
changed_reading.after: Fingertip precision also preserves the same embodied agent who can confront the record and cannot escape self-knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing developmental sequence supplies a generative model: apportioned fluid becomes attached matter, is measured into creation, and is made sound. Fingertip restoration can therefore be re-formation, not only retrieval of old pieces.

activation_trace.role: Planning and proportioning supply controlled morphological development.
Sound completion names the developmental finishing operation.
Fingertips are the fine differentiated outcome produced by the sequence.
Generative fluid from which form is apportioned supplies the sequence's minimal material origin.
Thick attached bodily matter supplies an intermediate material state.
Measuring and proportioning the thing supplies the transition from material to designed form.
Bringing creation into being supplies genuinely generative formation.
The exact repetition of sound completion links first formation directly back to نسوي in 75:4.

structural_cues: Ayat 75:37-39 progress from fluid to attached matter, creation, fashioning, and a differentiated pair; 75:38 repeats the focus verb's root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies staged transformation and the repeated تسوية operation; I infer that renewed fingertips may be generated afresh from minimal matter, while the alternative is that the closing sequence proves resurrection only by analogy with first creation.

changed_reading.before: The old body's scattered parts are recovered and reattached.
changed_reading.after: The body can be generated again through measured morphogenesis until even its differentiated fingertips reach completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The escape-refuge-settlement sequence activates constriction and fixedness in the focus roots: even the body's terminal margins cannot remain outside the reconstruction but are settled back into completed form.

activation_trace.role: Narrowing to a scant measure supplies closure down to the smallest bodily margin.
Sound completion supplies reintegration after every margin is recovered.
Remaining fixed or dwelling activates the possibility of terminal parts being firmly resettled.
Flight and escape supply the route that the reconstruction mechanism closes.
Refuge supplies the denied outside location where a fragment or person might remain.
Fixity and settlement reverse flight into an unavoidable final placement.

structural_cues: Ayat 75:10-12 move in sequence from asking for escape, to denying refuge, to naming final settlement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies escape, no refuge, settlement, and focus branches of narrowing and fixedness; I project the spatial sequence onto dispersed terminal matter, while the live alternative is that it concerns only the person's destination after resurrection.

changed_reading.before: The fingertips are a neutral demonstration of fine reconstruction.
changed_reading.after: The fingertips become the terminal test of inescapable reconstruction: no bodily margin remains outside the completed form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing قادر على أن construction repeats the focus capability frame and expands its object from fashioning fingertips to giving life after loss of life; 75:4 becomes a local demonstration inside the surah's total revival claim.

activation_trace.role: Effective capacity supplies the focus half of the repeated capability frame.
Fingertips provide the local fine-grained object later expanded to the whole dead.
The repeated capacity reaching effective control closes the same syntactic claim at surah scale.
Animated life supplies the positive endpoint to which reconstruction leads.
Loss of force and life supplies the total condition that the closing capacity reverses.

structural_cues: The قادرين على أن frame in 75:4 is echoed by بقادر على أن in 75:40, at the opening and close of the resurrection argument.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated capacity construction and the life-death reversal; I read the closing echo backward as making fingertip fashioning a miniature case of revival, while the alternative is that the two assertions are parallel but not premise and conclusion.

changed_reading.before: The focus makes a localized claim about reconstructing one difficult body part.
changed_reading.after: The localized fingertip claim is the fine-scale face of the closing claim that life itself can be restored after death.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because complete restoration usually dominates the reading, yet the equality branch attaches directly to نسوي and the plural fingertips supply things that can be equalized. Downstream prose should retain it only as a formal competing possibility, not assert that levelling or fusion is the settled sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The causative نسوي acts directly on the plural بنانه, with an available equality branch for س و ي.

activation_trace.role: Effective capacity permits reconfiguration as well as restoration.
Equality and equivalence activate literal levelling among multiple members.
The fingers and extremities are the multiple members whose differentiation could be altered.

changed_reading.before: Power is shown by reproducing the familiar differentiated fingers.
changed_reading.after: Power may also be shown by making the extremities level or equivalent, altering rather than merely reproducing their familiar differentiation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The clinging-scent branch is remote from the ordinary anatomical sense, but it belongs to the exact بنن root and combines with the self's inward witness to suggest an enduring personal trace at the fingertips. Downstream prose should call this a material analogy only, not a lexical translation or an explicit claim about fingerprints.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بنانه names the fingertips while another branch of the same root images something whose trace clings to an object.

activation_trace.role: Exact deliberate arrangement supplies preservation of particular detail.
A clinging scent or odor supplies the cross-material image of a persistent personal trace.
The thing itself or its identity links the persistent trace to the same person.
Inner sight supplies the self-recognizing evidentiary setting for that trace.

changed_reading.before: Fingertips are only small anatomical parts that demonstrate precision.
changed_reading.after: Fingertips can exploratorily image a personal trace that clings to the restored self and remains available to self-recognition.

strongest_changes: The direct 75:3-4 sequence turns fingertip fashioning into the fine-resolution completion of bone collection.
The body-cosmos-recitation repetitions of جمع activate reconstruction as ordered articulation, not mere aggregation.
The developmental sequence in 75:37-39 recasts restoration as generative morphogenesis, and the capability echo in 75:40 expands fingertip completion into renewed life.
The self-witness passage makes exact bodily continuity potentially relevant to accountable identity and agency.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package exposed three domains of gathering together with exact reprises of س و ي and ق د ر, making 75:4 a hinge between collection, calibrated individuation, and renewed life rather than a standalone appeal to small anatomy.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether نسوي primarily preserves differentiated fingertip form or also keeps alive the competing possibility of levelling the digits.
Whether the recitational gathering sequence intentionally models bodily ordering or only supports a reader-supplied cross-domain analogy.
Whether the self-evidence passage gives fingertip precision an identity-bearing function or leaves it as a pure demonstration of power.
